questions.prompt: When dealing with a numeric column that has 30% missing values, which imputation strategy best preserves the overall distribution while mitigating bias?

options.text: Delete all rows with missing values
Fill missing values with the column mean
Fill missing values with the column median
Fill missing values with the most frequent value

questions.explanation: The median is robust to outliers and keeps the distribution shape.

questions.prompt: Which pandas method returns a boolean Series indicating duplicate rows in a DataFrame?
questions.explanation: `.duplicated()` marks rows that are duplicates of previous ones.
